name: Manitoba

plates.name: Veterans
plates.fact: The veteran plate is free, and replacements never cost a thing.

plates.name: Firefighters
plates.supports: Manitoba Firefighters Burn Fund and Manitoba Fallen Firefighters Fund
plates.fact: Winnipeg firefighters can have their badge number on the plate.

plates.name: Paramedics
plates.supports: Canadian Mental Health Association (Manitoba and Winnipeg region)
plates.fact: Active and retired paramedics, including volunteers, and their immediate families qualify.

plates.name: Amateur radio operators
plates.fact: Manitoba ham plates carry the operator's call sign, which starts with VE4 or VA4.

plates.name: Basketball Manitoba
plates.supports: Basketball Manitoba's Basketball for Life Fund

plates.name: Brandon Wheat Kings
plates.fact: Proceeds from this hockey plate go to the Brandon Humane Society.

plates.name: Curl Manitoba
plates.supports: Curl Manitoba Curling For Life Endowment Fund

plates.name: Madox's Warriors
plates.fact: It raises awareness and funds for childhood cancer research.

plates.name: MMIWG2S
plates.fact: Two designs are offered: one with a red dress and one with a red handprint.

plates.name: Ride For Dad
plates.fact: It helps fund prostate cancer awareness, education and support.

plates.name: Support our Troops
plates.supports: Scholarships for reserve members and Canadian Armed Forces families posted to Manitoba

plates.name: University of Winnipeg
plates.supports: Scholarships for Wesmen athletes and inner-city youth sports programming
plates.fact: Proceeds fund scholarships for Wesmen athletes and inner-city youth sports.

plates.name: Winnipeg Blue Bombers
plates.fact: This special edition celebrates the Bombers' 107th Grey Cup championship.

plates.name: Winnipeg Blue Bombers (original gold design)
plates.fact: The original gold Bombers plate stopped selling for cars and trucks on June 1, 2020, but plenty are still on the road.

plates.name: Winnipeg Goldeyes
plates.supports: Winnipeg Goldeyes' Field of Dreams Foundation

plates.name: Winnipeg Jets Heritage
plates.fact: It celebrates the history of the Winnipeg Jets and went on sale September 13, 2021.

plates.name: Bilingual licence plate (Bienvenue)
plates.fact: It honours Manitoba's francophone heritage with the word "Bienvenue" (welcome).

about: Manitoba special-design plates, from the province's own list on 2026-10-26. Not rated yet: every plate is worth the same.

sources.title: Provincial and territorial licensing agencies, and the plates' sponsors
